name: PR Factory
style_reference_role: Inspected local image; style only, no identity or scenery carried over.
workflow: L1 generation, L1→L2 edit, L2→L3 edit. Then targeted builtin framing repairs: two attempts for L2 and one for L3. No manual raster manipulation.
qa_status: Selected L1/L2/L3 are fully framed, genuine alpha, no text/logos/scenery. Repaired L2/L3 solid artwork has at least 8% margin on every side. Ground tips land at approximately 89% and 91% canvas height rather than exact 90%.

levels.exact_prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: transparent isometric building sprite for an interactive Cancel City neighbourhood. NEW illustration. Reference portrait is STYLE ONLY: match its bold grotesque punk comic black ink outlines, dense scratchy crosshatching, distressed screen-printed vivid colour, textured hand-drawn details. Show ONE complete building, detached, centered, full structure visible, three-quarter isometric view from diagonally above, orthographic game camera, vertical walls upright. Two visible front/side faces meet at center; ground base is a small diamond-like isometric square. Use the same approximately 30-degree isometric view for all assets. Frame comfortably inside a square canvas with clear transparent margin, preserve room above roof. Include ONLY the building and its own narrow ground footprint, no street, no sky, no background scenery, no large shadow extending outside footprint. TRUE alpha transparent background, not white or checkerboard painted background. NO card frame, UI, captions, readable text, watermark or real logos. High detail at least 1024 square; legible silhouette at 250px. Level 1 starting building, compact and modest but expressive. Palette: lavender-violet. Subject: A compact three-storey lavender bureaucratic office factory, mismatched concrete slabs, large purple glass windows, complicated exposed ventilation pipes, a giant takeaway coffee cup on the roof with no writing, blank paper sheets escaping a roof vent, tiny cracked entry steps and violet neon window trim. Satirize corporate wellness and endless paperwork.
Style reference: the previously viewed CC026 resident portrait supplies the ink and print style only. Do not depict the portrait, people, helicopters, skyline or its background. Composition lock for the upgrade series: square 1024px canvas, stable narrow isometric footprint centered at approximately x=512, with base bottom near y=900; keep the level 1 roof/cup below y=310 to reserve clear vertical headroom for later floors. No painted checkerboard.
notes: Detailed compact three-storey lavender office factory, large blank purple coffee cup, exposed pipes and escaping paperwork.
Solid artwork has 27px bottom margin. Some nearly transparent pixels lie at canvas edges.

levels.exact_prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Framing-only repair of the attached PR Factory level 2 sprite. Current result is fully visible but still too large and too low. Keep 1254x1254 square canvas and TRUE transparent alpha. Uniformly scale THE ENTIRE EXISTING ARTWORK GROUP to 85% of its current size, keeping all building architecture, cup, papers, door, steps, base, balcony, pipe details, colours and isometric camera unchanged. Then position the group so its lowest ground tip is at y=1128 (90% canvas height), with at least 125 fully transparent pixels beneath it. Leave generous empty alpha margin above and all sides; none of the building or base may touch or approach a canvas edge. The entire sprite should occupy only the central approximately 70% of the square. Do not zoom back in. Do not add details or scenery. Preserve the same orthographic isometric camera, distressed black ink lavender-violet style, and precise building identity. This is ONLY whole-group scale and translation within an unchanged transparent canvas, no redesign. No text, logos, background or checkerboard.
notes: First variant is preserved; selected master uses authorized builtin framing-only repair.
Architecture/camera/identity visually retained; full base and all roof details visible.
Full building framed; minimum solid-art margin 138px (11%); ground tip approximately 89% canvas height.
Whole-group scaling and translation intentionally change original pixel base position; exact 90% requested placement differs by about 1% canvas height.
